# What in source drives GRPO − EI? (generated by `source_split.py`; do not edit by hand)

Thinking models, GRPO recipe v2, plain reads at B64 (ynez). Δ = GRPO arm − EI arm in
points of pass@k; 95% hierarchical-bootstrap intervals (4000 draws). human-written =
textbook72 + Charles149; generated = 13–20 + 21–30. Figures `fig_source_split_*` in
`experiment-summaries/2026-10-05-thinking-traces/figures/ynez/`.

## Proofs behind the proof features

- textbook72: 71 of 72 problems have a shortest found proof (no reference proofs exist); the rest get statement features only.
- Charles149, 140 problems solved by a headline arm: a proof feature taken from the shortest found proof agrees with the reference proof's for case split (∨E) 100%, ex falso (⊥E) 97%, ¬¬E (reductio / classical) 99%, nested ¬-subproof 99%, box depth 97%.
